thread.title: Apple (AAPL) Raised to Hold at BidaskClub

author: Logan Wallace
title: Apple (AAPL) Raised to Hold at BidaskClub
text:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was upgraded by research analysts at BidaskClub from a “sell” rating to a “hold” rating in a research report issued on Thursday.
AAPL has been the subject of several other research reports. Goldman Sachs Group set a $140.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” Wednesday. ValuEngine raised shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” Monday. HSBC restated a “neutral” rating and set a $160.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, January 30th. Citigroup reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $170.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, January 30th. Finally, Nomura dropped their price target on shares of Apple from $175.00 to $170.00 and set a “neutral” rating on the stock in a research note on Wednesday, January 30th. One analyst has sell rating, twenty-four have issued a hold rating and twenty-two have issued a buy rating to the company. The stock presently has an average rating of “Hold” and an average target price of $191.66.
Get Apple alerts: Shares of Apple stock opened at $174.24 on Thursday. The company has a quick ratio of 1.25, a current ratio of 1.30 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.79. Apple has a twelve month low of $142.00 and a twelve month high of $233.47. The stock has a market capitalization of $841.72 billion, a P/E ratio of 14.63, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.75 and a beta of 1.13.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, January 29th. The iPhone maker reported $4.18 EPS for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $4.17 by $0.01. The firm had revenue of $84.31 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $84.07 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 50.92% and a net margin of 22.72%. Analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.39 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.

About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
